query: select c.relname as table_name, c.relrowsecurity as rls_enabled, (select count(*) from pg_policies p where p.schemaname = 'public' and p.tablename = c.relname) as policy_count from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relkind = 'r' and c.relname in ('users','dashboard_report_schedules','audit_logs','webhook_deliveries','schema_drift_monitors','schema_drift_runs','tra_z_report_archive_schedules','tra_z_report_archives','tra_gateway_alert_settings','tra_gateway_alert_events','tra_vat_anomaly_settings','tra_vat_anomaly_events','bank_market_rates','dse_market_tickers','market_provider_settings','market_provider_uptime_logs','market_provider_incidents') order by c.relname limit 30
